title: Service-space reference supplement
status: Assistant-drafted English synthesis from named primary sources. Dates and local scope are retained; this does not assert that dated targets are current national requirements.

R01.title: Helsinki — response on early-childhood space planning
R01.scope: Planning practices described in the 2023 report; not a new national regulation. The displayed meeting deferred the motion. The source calls its floor-area measure huoneistoala and excludes kitchens and technical rooms.
R01.locator: Explanatory report: indoor planning target and yard provision

R02.title: Espoo — Postipuu school and daycare needs assessment
R02.scope: Municipal yard targets and project-specific sports-space choices in the Postipuu needs assessment. The hall follows the cited Espoo 2016 gym guidance; field location and size belong to this project.

R03.title: Kauniainen — starting information for a Finnish-language school centre
R03.edition: 7 June 2023, Education and Early Childhood Committee §38
R03.scope: New-school planning targets used in this investment study. Useful area and gross area are distinct quantities. Pupil forecasts determine capacity; the city does not give a universal residents-per-school ratio.
R03.locator: Pupil forecasts and dimensioning of new schools

R04.title: Tampere — Päiväkotien suunnitteluohje 2025
R04.scope: Tampere daycare design guidance. The smaller yard figure applies where the 20 m² target is difficult to achieve in built urban surroundings.

R05.title: Ministry of Education and Culture — Yleisten kirjastojen laatusuositus
R05.scope: The approximately 100 useful m²/1,000 residents figure is in the new 2010 space recommendations, p.55; small municipalities may need more. The 80%/2 km access benchmark is an older 2001–04 recommendation reproduced on p.26, not a newly adopted 2010 threshold.
R05.locator: Page 55: useful area; page 26: earlier access benchmark

serviceRows.label: Indoor area
serviceRows.qualifier: Target; excludes kitchens and technical rooms.

serviceRows.label: Yard
serviceRows.qualifier: The report explicitly excepts dense inner-city contexts; nearby green space is part of the planning context.

serviceRows.label: Play yard
serviceRows.qualifier: Growth and Learning sector target cited in the Postipuu assessment.

serviceRows.label: Play yard
serviceRows.qualifier: 20 m² is the target; at least 15 m² in built urban settings where achieving the target is difficult.

serviceRows.label: Open activity space
serviceRows.qualifier: Keep a continuous area for active games when arranging play equipment; it is within the yard, not an additional per-child allowance.

serviceRows.label: Useful floor area
serviceRows.qualifier: Target used for new-school investment options in the 2023 study.

serviceRows.label: Gross floor area
serviceRows.qualifier: Approximate gross-to-useful area conversion used by this study, not a general building factor.

serviceRows.label: Usable yard
serviceRows.qualifier: Children’s usable school yard target in the Postipuu needs assessment.

serviceRows.label: Sports hall
serviceRows.qualifier: Hall chosen for the Postipuu school project using Espoo’s 2016 sports-hall dimensioning guidance; ancillary rooms are additional.

serviceRows.label: Playing field
serviceRows.qualifier: Field size and maximum approximate distance stated for this project; no universal school catchment or sports standard is implied.
serviceRows.units: m field dimensions and approximate school-to-field distance

serviceRows.label: Useful floor area
serviceRows.qualifier: Useful space across municipal library provision, not a minimum population for a branch.

serviceRows.label: Service-point access
serviceRows.qualifier: Earlier urban-area service benchmark reproduced in the 2010 publication; local structure and mobile services matter. This is not a 2 km map circle guaranteeing route access.
serviceRows.units: percent of population and km distance to service point

editorialDecisions: Replace decorative resident tiles and the library area-square with semantic tables.
Keep the numbered green-distance diagram and all historical green provisions.
Move the Seinäjoki 2017 growth trigger and Helsinki 2020 health-station proposal to Sources. They are historical local cases, not population thresholds for new neighbourhoods.
Keep the baseline evidence register unchanged; this supplement is appended in the generated edition.
